What we offer

Objective: Find the right opportunities

Your objectives

  • Find the right opportunities
  • Enter and grow in Japan or India
  • Turn interest into commitments
  • Set up and improve operations
  • Create new business and sustain value
  • Coordinate complex initiatives

View all services

← Back to all services

Objective

Find the right opportunities

Understand demand, assess where your strengths fit and identify suitable partners. Decide what merits further attention.

Services for this objective

Select an offering to see what it involves.

  • Assess opportunities

    Explore where your strengths meet demand, test the commercial potential and decide which opportunities deserve attention—and which to leave aside.

    4 offerings

    • Opportunity assessment

      Find where your strengths could meet demand.

      What we do
      Explore sectors, customer needs and applications in the other market, and assess their fit with your capabilities.
      What you receive
      An assessed long list of opportunities, with reasons for including each.
      Why this matters
      A grounded starting point for deciding where to investigate further.

      A prioritized short list or an entry case is not included automatically; each is a separate offering you can select.

      Directly related experience

      Our team’s individual experience

      • Developing a platform evolution roadmap

      Discuss this offering

    • Customer and counterpart screening
      What we do
      Identify and screen potential customers, partners and competitors.
      What you receive
      A screened list with contact routes.
      Why this matters
      Understand whom you would actually be dealing with.

      Discuss this offering

    • Commercial qualification
      What we do
      Test shortlisted opportunities for buyer value, economics, entry requirements and risk.
      What you receive
      A qualification summary.
      Why this matters
      Identify weaknesses before committing more resources.

      Directly related experience

      Our team’s individual experience

      • Creating a new business possibility from existing assets

      Discuss this offering

    • Prioritized pursuit agenda
      What we do
      Rank qualified opportunities and identify first steps, resources and decision points.
      What you receive
      A proposed agenda for management approval.
      Why this matters
      Decide where to act, and when to continue or stop.

      Directly related experience

      Our team’s individual experience

      • Shaping a ten-market growth strategy

      Discuss this offering

    Discuss this service

  • Adapt your offer for the market

    Understand what buyers value and reshape your product, service or commercial approach around how they buy.

    4 offerings

    • Buyer-requirement assessment
      What we do
      Explore buyers’ needs, purchasing criteria and economics.
      What you receive
      A profile of buyer requirements.
      Why this matters
      Understand what buyers value and will pay for.

      Directly related experience

      Our team’s individual experience

      • Helping Indian manufacturers reach US customers

      Illustrative scenarios (hypothetical)

      • A Japanese manufacturer exploring India

      Discuss this offering

    • Offer adaptation and localization
      What we do
      Work with your team to adapt features, packaging, support, documentation and pricing.
      What you receive
      A redesigned offer.
      Why this matters
      Present an offer shaped for the market.

      Directly related experience

      Our team’s individual experience

      • Helping Indian manufacturers reach US customers
      • Developing a US market for products made in India
      • Developing a platform evolution roadmap

      Discuss this offering

    • Commercial validation
      What we do
      Test the adapted offer with prospective buyers.
      What you receive
      Buyer feedback and a recommendation to proceed, revise or set aside.
      Why this matters
      Learn before making a larger commitment.

      Discuss this offering

    • Market-entry business case
      What we do
      Set out the customer segment, entry route, investment, economics and risks.
      What you receive
      A business case for your decision.
      Why this matters
      Judge whether the proposed investment makes sense.

      Discuss this offering

    Discuss this service

  • Find and develop suitable partnerships

    Identify potential partners, assess their suitability and establish shared expectations before either side commits.

    3 offerings

    • Partner search and qualification
      What we do
      Assess candidates’ capabilities, capacity, reputation, financial standing and interest.
      What you receive
      A qualified shortlist.
      Why this matters
      Focus discussions on suitable potential partners.

      Directly related experience

      Our team’s individual experience

      • Concluding technology partnerships with Israeli and Korean companies

      Illustrative scenarios (hypothetical)

      • An Indian manufacturer looking for a Japanese technology partner

      Discuss this offering

    • Partner fit and expectations
      What we do
      Bring parties together to discuss contributions, responsibilities, economics and working practices.
      What you receive
      A shared statement of expectations.
      Why this matters
      Surface differences before commitments are made.

      Directly related experience

      Illustrative scenarios (hypothetical)

      • An Indian manufacturer looking for a Japanese technology partner

      Discuss this offering

    • Partnership development
      What we do
      Support introductions, visits and early work together.
      What you receive
      A documented basis for a commercial agreement, if both parties proceed.
      Why this matters
      Develop understanding beyond an initial meeting.

      Directly related experience

      Our team’s individual experience

      • Developing two routes into Turkey

      Illustrative scenarios (hypothetical)

      • An Indian manufacturer looking for a Japanese technology partner

      Discuss this offering

    Discuss this service

You can start with one focused piece of work. Getting started

Each assignment includes the offerings agreed with you. Recommendations support your decisions; customers, partners and financiers make their own decisions.
